categories.title: Basics
categories.blurb: Opening your first rift, gates in the world, dying and leaving.

entries.name: How to play
entries.summary: Hollowdeep adds rifts: short, instanced dungeons in the sky with waves of custom mobs, elite affixes, four themed bosses and a vault of relics at the end.

blocks.html: Hollowdeep adds rifts: short, instanced dungeons in the sky with waves of custom mobs, elite affixes, four themed bosses and a vault of relics at the end.

• Craft a Rift Key (recipe below), or find a Rift Gate that tears open near you.
  • Gather your friends: everyone standing within 6 blocks of you when you use the key comes along.
  • Use the key. The rift builds in a few seconds, then everyone is pulled inside.
  • Walk into the first chamber. The gate shuts behind you and the waves start. Clear every wave to open the next gate.
  • After the last chamber comes the boss arena. Beat the boss and the vault gate opens.
  • Loot the vault chests. You have 4 min before the rift collapses and sends you home.

• Inside a rift you are in Adventure mode: you can't break or place blocks. Your old game mode comes back when you leave.
  • Every rift has a time limit (see Rift tiers). If it runs out the rift collapses and you go home without the vault.
  • If you die, you get a Soul Tether when you respawn. Use it to jump back in.
  • The crying obsidian sigil in the entrance (and in the vault) is the way out. Stand still on it for 3 seconds to leave for good.
  • When you leave or the rift ends you go back to the exact spot you left from.
  • Chests in the chambers are loot caches, but some are Mimics.

Bosses drop Rift Cores and every kill can drop Hollow Essence. Use them to upgrade your key to Rift Key II to V: higher tiers have more chambers, tougher mobs, more vault chests and better relic odds. Relics are the gear Hollowdeep is built around: carry them for their bonuses and use them for their powers.

entries.name: Rift Gates
entries.summary: Rift Gates are free rifts that tear open in the Overworld near players. Tap the lodestone in the middle to open a rift, no key needed.

blocks.html: Rift Gates are free rifts that tear open in the Overworld near players. Tap the lodestone in the middle to open a rift, no key needed.

• Once a minute, each player on the surface of the Overworld (between y 55 and 200) has a 10% chance to make a gate appear.
  • The gate lands 28 to 52 blocks away, and chat tells you how far and in which direction.
  • Gates only appear on flat, natural ground (grass, dirt, sand, stone, snow and so on) with open sky, so they never land on your builds.
  • There are at most 6 gates in the world at once.
  • A gate fades after 30 minutes of real time, and the ground under it is put back.
The further from world spawn, the higher the tier of the rift a gate opens:

Distance from world spawnRift tier
under 1,500 blocksTier I
from 1,500 to 3,500 blocksTier II
from 3,500 to 6,000 blocksTier III
from 6,000 to 9,000 blocksTier IV
9,000 blocks or moreTier V

A 5 by 5 platform of polished blackstone bricks with a crying obsidian pillar topped by a soul lantern in each corner and a lodestone in the middle. Tap the lodestone to open the rift. Like a key, it takes everyone standing within 6 blocks of you. Breaking the lodestone removes the gate.

entries.name: Dying and leaving
entries.summary: How to get out of a rift, and what happens when you die in one.

blocks.html: How to get out of a rift, and what happens when you die in one.

When you die inside a rift you respawn in the world as usual, with a Soul Tether in your inventory. Use it to return to the rift's entrance while the rift is still open. Your items stay where you died; vanilla rules apply, so they despawn after 5 minutes. Chat tells you the coordinates.
Your friends carry on without you. The rift stays open while at least one member is inside, and closes by itself if it has been empty for 2 min 30 s.

The crying obsidian sigil just inside the entrance is the exit. Stand still on it for 3 seconds. Leaving this way is permanent: you are no longer a member of the rift, and your Soul Tether stops working.

ReasonWhat happens
Boss beatenThe vault opens. 4 min later the rift collapses and everyone inside goes home.
Time ran outThe rift collapses. Nobody gets the vault.
EmptyNobody has been inside for 2 min 30 s: the rift fades.
Admin/scriptevent hollowdeep:end closes every rift (see Commands).

Players are always sent back to where they were standing when they entered. If the world crashes or restarts with a rift open, the rift is cleaned up on the next load and anyone stuck in it is sent home.

categories.title: Rift mechanics
categories.blurb: How a rift is laid out, the five tiers and their numbers, themes, modifiers and loot.

entries.name: Inside a rift
entries.summary: Every rift is a straight run of rooms built high in the sky: an entrance, a row of chambers, the boss arena and the vault.

blocks.html: Every rift is a straight run of rooms built high in the sky: an entrance, a row of chambers, the boss arena and the vault.

RoomSizeWhat happens there
Entrance15 long, 15 wideWhere you arrive. The exit sigil is here.
Chambers25 long, 21 wideWaves of mobs. A gate seals the way on until the chamber is clear. Loot caches line the walls.
Boss arena35 long, 33 wideThe theme's boss rises when you walk in. It can't leave the arena.
Vault13 long, 11 wideOpens when the boss dies: the relic chest and the vault chests, plus a second exit sigil.
Short corridors join the rooms, each with a gate. The number of chambers depends on the tier.
A chamber wakes up when you step into it. Each chamber has several waves; the next wave comes when the last mob of the one before it is dead. When the last wave is cleared the next gate opens.
The number of mobs in a wave is:
base + chamber number + 2 × wave number + (players − 1) × per extra player, capped at the tier's maximum. Hollow Wisps come in threes but only count as two.
Chamber and wave numbers start at 0. A Bloodmoon rift multiplies the total by 1.35 before the cap. The numbers for each tier are on Rift tiers.

Which mobs show up depends on how deep you are: the first chamber has only Crypt Brutes and Wisps, later chambers add Hexcasters, Warded Husks and Bone Choruses, and from the second chamber on the theme's own mobs join in.
The action bar shows the tier, which chamber you're in, how many foes are left, the time remaining and the rift's modifiers.

• Up to 3 rifts can be open at once in a world. Opening another tells you to wait.
  • Each open rift uses one ticking area. Bedrock allows 10 per world, so if yours are all taken the rift can't form (your key is given back and chat tells you to remove one with /tickingarea list).
  • You can only be in one rift at a time, and rifts can only be opened in the Overworld.
  • Rifts are built at x 30,000, y 270, far from anything you've built. Vanilla monsters that wander in are removed.

entries.summary: Some rifts roll modifiers when they open. Each one makes the rift harder and pushes its relics toward higher rarities.

blocks.html: Some rifts roll modifiers when they open. Each one makes the rift harder and pushes its relics toward higher rarities.

TierModifiers

A rift never rolls the same modifier twice. The modifiers are announced in chat when you arrive and shown on the HUD.

The relic bonuses of every modifier on the rift are added up. That many percentage points are taken from the Common and Rare odds (Common first) and handed out 70% to Epic and 30% to Legendary. It applies to the vault relic and the boss relic.
Mimic chests, Wisps and Ward Crystals don't get Swift or Armored, and they never explode.

entries.name: Loot
entries.summary: What drops from mobs and bosses, and what's in the chamber caches and the vault at each tier.

blocks.html: What drops from mobs and bosses, and what's in the chamber caches and the vault at each tier.

• Mob drops. A normal mob has a 55% chance to drop 1 Hollow Essence; an elite drops 2 to 4 and a Mimic 3 to 6. Each kill also has a chance of one extra Essence equal to the best Fortune bonus in the party (see Relics). Mobs raised by a Bone Chorus, summoned by an elite or called in by a boss drop nothing.
  • Caches. Each chamber has one real chest of loot, and usually a decoy that is a Mimic (50% chance, or always two in a Haunted rift).
  • The boss. Drops 1 + tier Rift Cores and 10 + 4 × tier Hollow Essence, and a themed boss also drops its theme's relic.
  • The vault. One chest holds a relic plus Essence and Rift Cores; the rest hold valuables. Relics are rolled the moment the chest is filled.

categories.title: Elites
categories.blurb: Affixed mobs with more health, nastier tricks and better drops.

entries.name: Elites
entries.summary: Any regular mob can spawn as an elite: it gets an affix, extra health, a coloured name and drops more Hollow Essence.

blocks.html: Any regular mob can spawn as an elite: it gets an affix, extra health, a coloured name and drops more Hollow Essence.

AffixWhat it does
ShieldedAbsorption IV: 16 extra health as yellow hearts on top of its normal health.
VampiricSpeed I, and it heals 60% of the damage it deals to you.
ExplosiveExplodes when it dies (a bigger blast than Volatile). It doesn't break blocks.
SummonerEvery 10 seconds, while a player is within 24 blocks, it summons 2 Wisps (up to 14 in the rift). Summoned Wisps drop nothing.

The chance for each mob is the tier's base chance, plus 3% for each chamber after the first, plus 15% in a Bloodmoon rift. See Rift tiers for the numbers.
Wisps, Mimics, Ward Crystals, Ember Imps, bosses and anything raised or summoned are never elite.

categories.title: Bosses
categories.blurb: The four bosses, their abilities and phases, and how they scale.

entries.name: Boss fights
entries.summary: Every rift ends with its theme's boss. All four fight in three phases, call in adds, and enrage if the fight takes too long.

blocks.html: Every rift ends with its theme's boss. All four fight in three phases, call in adds, and enrage if the fight takes too long.

• Phase 1 (full to 2/3 health): the boss uses its phase 1 abilities.
  • Phase 2 (below 2/3): it announces itself in chat, calls in a group of adds and unlocks more abilities. From now on it also calls more adds every so often (only while fewer than 12 are alive).
  • Phase 3 (below 1/3): another wave of adds, every ability, all cooldowns 30% shorter, Speed II, and from Tier III up Strength I.
If the fight lasts too long the boss enrages: chat says ENRAGED! and it gets Speed III and Strength.

categories.title: Relics
categories.blurb: Rolled gear with rarities, bonuses and powers.

entries.name: Relics
entries.summary: Relics are Hollowdeep's gear. Each one rolls a rarity and random bonuses, and most also have a power you use.

blocks.html: Relics are Hollowdeep's gear. Each one rolls a rarity and random bonuses, and most also have a power you use.

RarityBonusesBonus strength
Common1× 1
Rare2× 1.3
Epic3× 1.7
Legendary4× 2.2

The rarity and bonuses are written on the relic's tooltip when it is rolled, and its name is coloured by rarity. Each bonus is different. The odds of each rarity depend on the tier and the rift's modifiers.

BonusDoesCommonRareEpicLegendary
PowerExtra damage to Hollowdeep mobs, as a % of each hit5 to 8%6 to 10%8 to 13%11 to 17%
HasteShorter relic cooldowns (capped at 60% in total)6 to 10%8 to 13%11 to 17%14 to 22%
LeechHeals you for this % of the damage you deal3 to 5%4 to 7%5 to 9%7 to 11%
VigorHealth Boost: 2 extra hearts per point (up to 7 points)1 to 11 to 21 to 22 to 3
FortuneChance per kill of one extra Hollow Essence10 to 15%12 to 20%16 to 26%21 to 33%

• Relics work from anywhere in your inventory; they don't need to be in your hand.
  • If you carry two of the same relic, only the one with the higher total bonuses counts.
  • Only your best four relics (by total bonuses) count at once.
  • Power only adds damage against Hollowdeep mobs; Leech works on anything you hit.
  • Fortune uses the best Fortune in the party, not everyone's added together.

Every vault has a relic chest with one random relic. The Forge Tyrant, Winter Matriarch and Briar Colossus also drop their own theme's relic. Relics taken from the creative inventory or with /give keep their power but have no rarity and no bonuses: only relics from rifts are rolled.

categories.title: Items
categories.blurb: Keys, the materials you collect, the Soul Tether and the Rift Ledger.

entries.name: Rift Keys
entries.summary: Keys open rifts. Craft the first one from vanilla items, then upgrade it tier by tier with Hollow Essence and Rift Cores.

blocks.html: Keys open rifts. Craft the first one from vanilla items, then upgrade it tier by tier with Hollow Essence and Rift Cores.

Use the key to open a rift of its tier. Everyone within 6 blocks who isn't already in a rift comes with you. If the rift can't form (all slots busy, no free ticking area, or its chunks don't load) you get the key back.
Keys stack to 16. Each upgrade uses up the key below it.

entries.name: Hollow Essence
entries.summary: The common currency of the rifts. It drops from mobs and fills caches and vaults, and goes into keys and the Rift Ledger.

blocks.html: The common currency of the rifts. It drops from mobs and fills caches and vaults, and goes into keys and the Rift Ledger.

Most mobs have a 55% chance to drop one, elites drop 2 to 4, Mimics 3 to 6 and bosses 10 + 4 × tier. Caches and vault chests hold more (see Loot). The Fortune bonus gives a chance of one extra per kill.

• Rift Key II (4) and Rift Key III (4)
  • Rift Ledger (2)

entries.name: Rift Core
entries.summary: The heart of a beaten boss. Rift Cores are what you need to upgrade keys past Tier II.

blocks.html: The heart of a beaten boss. Rift Cores are what you need to upgrade keys past Tier II.
Every boss drops 1 + tier Rift Cores, and the vault relic chest often has more (see Loot).

• Rift Key III (2)
  • Rift Key IV (3)
  • Rift Key V (4)

entries.name: Soul Tether
entries.summary: You get one when you respawn after dying in a rift. Use it to return to the rift's entrance.

blocks.html: You get one when you respawn after dying in a rift. Use it to return to the rift's entrance.

It only works while the rift you died in is still open and you are still one of its members. If the rift has ended it frays into nothing when you use it. Using it while you're already inside does nothing.
You land at the rift's entrance, not where you died. Your dropped items are where you fell.
See Dying and leaving.

entries.name: Rift Ledger
entries.summary: A book that keeps your rift record. Use it to see your stats and the server's top delvers.

blocks.html: A book that keeps your rift record. Use it to see your stats and the server's top delvers.
Rifts opened, rifts cleared, kills, deaths, and your fastest clear time at each tier.
The five players with the most clears (kills break ties), and the fastest clear at each tier. Offline players are included.
Clears are also kept on the hd_clears scoreboard. /scriptevent hollowdeep:board shows it on the sidebar.

categories.title: Commands
categories.blurb: Admin and testing commands, and hooks for other add-ons.

entries.name: Commands
entries.summary: Hollowdeep's commands all use /scriptevent, so they need cheats on (or a command block).

blocks.html: Hollowdeep's commands all use /scriptevent, so they need cheats on (or a command block).

CommandWhat it does
/scriptevent hollowdeep:open 3Opens a rift of tier 1 to 5 for you, without a key.
/scriptevent hollowdeep:key 3Gives you a Rift Key of tier 1 to 5.
/scriptevent hollowdeep:endCloses every open rift and sends everyone home.
/scriptevent hollowdeep:statsShows your Rift Ledger stats.
/scriptevent hollowdeep:topShows the Top Delvers.
/scriptevent hollowdeep:boardShows Rift Clears on the sidebar.
There's no command to spawn a Rift Gate; use hollowdeep:open to test rifts.
Other add-ons can add their items to vault chests. Registrations are saved in the world.

CommandWhat it does
/scriptevent hollowdeep:register_drop <item> <chance%> <min> <max> <minTier>Every vault chest in a rift of at least that tier has that % chance to get min to max of the item. Registering the same item again replaces it.
/scriptevent hollowdeep:unregister_drop <item>Removes it.
/scriptevent hollowdeep:dropsLists what's registered.
Example: /scriptevent hollowdeep:register_drop myaddon:star_shard 25 1 3 2
Hollowdeep also announces what happens, as /scriptevent hollowdeep:event with a JSON message, so other add-ons can react:

typeSent whenData
rift_openA rift openstier, theme, mods, players
boss_killA boss diestier, theme, mods, players, ticks (clear time)
elite_killA player kills an eliteplayer, affix, tier
